summary: Code-quality refactor regression pass (localStorage→sessionStorage, catch logging, stable keys). All critical user-facing flows verified end-to-end with no regressions detected.
passed: Backend: POST /api/auth/login client@demo.com → 200, returns user + token (jwt). httpOnly access_token cookie set.
Backend: GET /api/auth/me works with both Bearer header (Authorization: Bearer <token>) → 200 and httpOnly cookie alone → 200.
Backend: GET /api/notifications → 200, includes existing 'new_applicant' notification (kind=new_applicant) – flow from previous iteration intact.
Backend: POST /api/upload (multipart image/png) → 200 with {id,url,content_type,filename}. GET /api/files/{path} via Bearer header → 200; via ?auth= query param → 200.
Frontend: /login page loads, login with client@demo.com / demo1234 redirects to /dashboard.
Frontend: After login sessionStorage.ab_token IS present; localStorage.ab_token is NOT present (refactor verified). Only PostHog-related keys remain in localStorage.
Frontend: Dashboard renders 'As Client (3)' tab with project cards (Notif retest, Test Notif Project, Logo for cafe).
Frontend: Header notification bell shows badge '1', is clickable and opens dropdown without error.
Frontend: /browse loads without errors after login.
Frontend: /post page renders FileUploader (data-testid=file-uploader-btn present and visible).

Frontend integration: Upload small PNG via FileUploader → preview tile (data-testid=file-item-0) renders with and the image fetches successfully (200) using sessionStorage token both via ?auth= and Bearer header.
Frontend: After page reload while logged in, /api/auth/me returns 200 (httpOnly cookie keeps session alive even though sessionStorage may be cleared on tab close).
Frontend: Logout (header icon button) clears sessionStorage.ab_token (now null) and /api/auth/me subsequently returns 401 – session and cookie both invalidated.
Console: 0 console errors observed across the full flow.
notes: Post-project route is /post (not /post-project). FileUploader confirmed under that route.
Logout control is icon-only button in header (last header button); no data-testid='logout-btn' exists – minor maintainability note, not a regression.
